programme.title: Love Always, Santa
programme.desc: A widow's daughter writes to Santa Claus, asking for her mother to find love again. When a struggling writer receives the letter, he finds new inspiration and the beginnings of a romance.

programme.title: Meet Me Under the Mistletoe
programme.desc: Rival real estate agents both make the same wish during the first snow of the winter: to win the most coveted listing in town. As the business competitors begrudgingly work together, they learn the house comes with a special commission: love.

programme.title: Christmas by Candlelight
programme.desc: Juliet pitches selling Christmas memory candles to her boss, and asks candle store owner Tom to create new scents. He refuses at first but agrees after realizing the money will help make his daughter's Christmas wish come true.

programme.title: Royally Wrapped for Christmas
programme.desc: Lindsay, the NY director of an international charity organization, is called to the Kingdom of Veronia by the royal family to interview for the job of overseeing the whole operation. During the interview process, she finds true love with the prince.

programme.title: Christmas Sweethearts
programme.desc: When a woman returns home to find her ex in a relationship, she enlists her best friend to act as her fake boyfriend.

programme.title: Our Christmas Wedding
programme.desc: Roles reverse as Nicole's boss plans newly engaged Nicole and Michael's wedding in two weeks at Christmas.

programme.title: Christmas Wreaths and Ribbons
programme.desc: A woman receives help from a selfless neighbor when an arm injury puts her holiday wreath deliveries in jeopardy.

programme.title: Snowmance
programme.desc: A true romantic finally gets her chance at the love she's always dreamed of when a little Christmas magic brings her snowman to life.

programme.title: Pencil Me in for Christmas
programme.desc: An aspiring illustrator teams up with a demanding author to work on a children's book. As they create their Christmas-themed project in a nostalgic small town, they find themselves rediscovering the holiday spirit.

programme.title: Christmas at Mistletoe Manor
programme.desc: When a cooking show influencer travels to a centuries-old English castle to honor a World War II nurse, she finds herself swept up by the castle's holiday magic and the unexpected warmth of its charming proprietor.

programme.title: Christmas on Candy Cane Lane
programme.desc: Ivy Donaldson struggles with her mom's shadow, Muriel, the Christmas darling of Icicle Falls. She is now separated from her husband Rob and tries her best with her daughter.

programme.title: The Christmas Calendar
programme.desc: When Emily, a struggling baker in a small town, receives a handmade Christmas calendar from a secret admirer, the local residents become obsessed with finding out the identity of the sender.

programme.title: Love at the Christmas Contest
programme.desc: Angie enters a tree decorating contest to honor the memory of her mother. To Angie's surprise, her high school sweetheart, David, and his daughter, Gabby, have entered the contest as well.

programme.title: A Royal Christmas Ballet
programme.desc: A retired ballerina finds unexpected romance while working with a visiting team of royal ambassadors to stage the holiday season's performance of

programme.title: A Christmas Wish in Hudson
programme.desc: A woman takes a shot at love after seeing a widowed firefighter and chef on a cooking show. With the help of his daughter, the two of them might find love this Christmas.

programme.title: Destined 2: Christmas Once More
programme.desc: Theo continues to miss connecting with his girlfriend, Kim, as he attempts to propose at Christmas.

programme.title: A Christmas Star
programme.desc: An astronomer predicts that a new meteor shower will appear over a tiny town, but she must convince the locals to help with her discovery at the expense of a Christmas tradition.

programme.title: 12 Games of Christmas
programme.desc: Two old friends and a group of their neighbors are transported into a Christmas-themed board game during a Christmas party.

programme.title: The Great Christmas Switch
programme.desc: In an effort to get away from their problems, identical twins Bianca, a single city girl with a Scrooge-like boss, and Kaelynn, a single mother of two, decide to switch places for Christmas.

programme.title: Destined at Christmas
programme.desc: After Kim and Theo meet in the midst of Black Friday shopping madness, they are determined to meet again.

programme.title: Matchmaker Christmas
programme.desc: As the Christmas party for a book publishing company approaches, editor Maggie volunteers to help her boss, Amanda, find a date.

programme.title: Christmas Lovers Anonymous
programme.desc: A best-selling author hides her love for Christmas after an ugly break-up, but finds love again when she joins a website for people who are crazy about Christmas.

programme.title: Christmas on Every Page
programme.desc: A woman returns home for the holidays to help her mother's struggling bookstore. As she reconnects with her roots, she starts to question whether success is measured by career milestones -- or by love, creativity, and the joy of truly belonging.

programme.title: Christmas Time Is Here
programme.desc: A small-town real estate agent desperately tries to convince her widowed father not to sell the family resort to a prospective buyer.

programme.title: Christmas Sweethearts
programme.desc: When a woman returns home to find her ex in a relationship, she enlists her best friend to act as her fake boyfriend.
